ex.s: Mabry works circles around all the students， cleaning up messes others don't want to touch． He doesn't expect a lot． Mabry said he hadn't planned to do much for his milestone birthday，so he was happy the students had prepared the surprise celebration．
ex.t: 马布里围着所有学生忙碌，清理别人不愿碰的脏乱。他要求不多。马布里说他原本没有打算为这个里程碑式的生日做什么，所以学生们准备了这场惊喜庆祝活动，他很高兴。

ex.s: I’m telling you, my happy feet barely touched the ground all the way home.
ex.t: 我跟你说，我快乐的脚几乎没碰到地面，一路走回家。

defs.def: to be or come so close together that there is no space between 两个或以上的东西、表面等

ex.s: The researchers found that the dogs were able to pick the angry or happy face by touching a picture of it with their noses more often than one would expect by random chance.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，狗能够通过用鼻子触碰图片来选择愤怒或快乐的面孔，其正确率高于随机概率。

ex.s: “It was extremely touching and comforting to know that somebody had taken the time to do that for my family.
ex.t: "得知有人花时间为我的家人这样做，真的非常感人，令人欣慰。

ex.s: Amazingly, the trees grow in such a way that their leaves and branches, although close together, never actually touch those of another tree.
ex.t: 令人惊奇的是，这些树的生长方式使它们的叶子和树枝虽然靠得很近，却从不真正碰到另一棵树的叶子和树枝。

defs.def: to move sth, especially in such a way that you damage it; to hit or harm sb 常用于否定句
to make sb feel upset or sympathetic 感动；触动；使同情

ex.s: The students took on diverse topics and turned in stories, 10 to 20 pages each, with characters that broadened my view and touched my heart.
ex.t: 学生们选择了各种不同的主题，交上来的故事每篇10到20页，其中的人物开阔了我的视野，也触动了我的心。

ex.s: She was touched by Miss Chevalier’s trust.
ex.t: 离中心较远的地方住着平民和劳动者。

ex.s: The most memorable scene is towards the end of the movie when, during Mia’s darkest moment of self-doubt, she is touched by a letter her father left her.
ex.t: 最难忘的场景在电影接近结尾时：在米娅最黑暗的自我怀疑时刻，她被父亲留下的信触动。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

to eat, drink or use sth 通常用于否定句

to reach a particular level, etc. 达到（某一水平等）

to be seen on sb's face for a short time （在脸上）闪现，掠过
to reach the ground at the bottom of an area of water 触到水底
to reach the worst possible state or condition 到最坏境况；到最低点；跌到谷底

to score a try by putting the ball on the ground behind the other team's goal line 橄榄球
the sense that enables you to be aware of things and what they are like when you put your hands and fingers on them 触觉；触感

ex.s: Whether they use a sense of touch in the test
ex.t: 它们在测试中是否使用了触觉

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.t: 通过触摸熟悉的物体。

ex.s: Why do the leaves and branches of different trees avoid touching each other?
ex.t: 为什么不同树木的枝叶会避免相互接触？

ex.s: Touching the exhibits.
ex.t: 触摸展品。

ex.s: In the case of emperors, the act required the person to touch their head to the ground.
ex.t: 在皇帝的情况下，该礼节要求人把头触地。

ex.s: In Chile, you may never touch any food with your fingers.
ex.t: 在智利，你绝不能用手指接触任何食物。

ex.t: “我认为，每个人表现出来的信念，有33人触摸过他。

defs.def: the way that sth feels when you put your hand or fingers on it or when it comes into contact with your body 触摸时的感觉
a small detail that is added to sth in order to improve it or make it complete 修饰；润色；装点
a way or style of doing sth 作风；风格；手法
a very small amount 一点儿；少许
slightly; a little 轻微；稍许
the area outside the lines that mark the sides of the playing field 边线以外的区域
to no longer have any contact with sb/sth 失去联系

ex.s: Somewhere along the way, however, I lost touch with my creative self.
ex.t: 然而在某个时候我与创造性的自我失去了联系。

ex.s: Nowadays, we can move around the world and still stay in touch with the people that we want to remain friends with.
ex.t: 如今，我们可以在世界各地活动，仍然与我们想要保持友谊的人保持联系。

ex.s: Nowadays, we can…stay in touch with the people that we want to remain friends with.

ex.s: My wife suggested I get in touch with my brother, but I resisted, thinking he should call first.
